reviews.rationale: The crop visibly includes the user-facing free-text query interface for CellWhisperer, which is an actual model input route.
The crop shows the text-query interface and the LLM-generated query variants that are fed into the embedding model.
The crop clearly shows scRNA-seq being converted into a gene-expression matrix and then into a cell sentence, which is the model-visible input route.
The crop visibly shows both the DNA-sequence carrier and the English prompt entering the ChatNT pipeline, matching the model input interface.
The crop directly shows the noisy diffusion state x_t and the immediate geometry-processing stack that consumes it.
